info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Actions Management API
info.description: The Operational Actions Management API enables businesses to effectively manage and automate various IT operations within their banking platforms. It provides essential services for initiating and controlling operational tasks, ensuring streamlined workflows and enhanced productivity. This API is primarily utilized by IT administrators and operation teams looking to perform actions like task scheduling, resource allocation, and incident management. Users can interact with the platform to optimize performance and maintain system integrity through well-defined operational actions.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new operational action within the IT management platform, facilitating better management and oversight of various operations.
